about: The studio's narrator voices. No recording is bundled: each voice is made when the film is made — offline by the phone's own speech engine (Android TextToSpeech) at the pitch and pace given under 'phone', or online by the neural voice named under 'natural' (the studio's natural voices). A recorded narrator can always be chosen instead from the user's own voice library.
licence: Voice definitions: part of KahaniFilm. The speech is produced by the phone's speech engine or the online neural voice service at the time the film is made; no third-party audio is distributed in the app.

voices.name: दादी माँ की कहानी
voices.best_for: bedtime stories, folk tales, family stories, gentle morals
voices.sample: बहुत समय पहले की बात है, एक छोटे से गाँव में एक बूढ़ी दादी रहती थीं।

voices.name: नाना जी
voices.best_for: old tales, village stories, lessons of life
voices.sample: सुनो बच्चों, आज मैं तुम्हें एक ऐसी कहानी सुनाता हूँ जो मेरे दादा ने मुझे सुनाई थी।

voices.name: कथावाचक
